item.title: New flights from East Midlands Airport to Jersey from spring
item.description: East Midlands Airport is pleased to welcome Loganair as a new airline, as it launches a new daily route to Jersey from the spring. item.title: Government U-turn as plans to cancel some local council elections scrapped
item.description: Following legal advice, the Secretary of State has withdrawn his original decision to postpone 30 local elections due to take place in May 2026. The government was prepared to defend the plans against a legal challenge by Reform UK in court, but has now backed down after receiving new legal advice. item.title: Nottingham: City Council announces £25m more cash for front line services in new budget
item.description: Nottingham City Council says it has put forward a fully balanced budget for 2026/27, which would see an additional £25 million invested in front-line services while keeping Council Tax increases significantly below the maximum allowed.
